w: In the morning Pramukh Swami Maharaj was returning to his residence from the homes of Ramanbhai and Dahyabhai Patel. On the way, seeing Kiran, a youth who had come from Nairobi, he had the car stopped. He opened the window and, showing this wealthy youth, who had come here for the first time, a few small houses and the wheat fields, said, "This is our home, even if it has mud walls and a bamboo roof." For Swamishri, home is the place smeared with the dust of his guru's memory.

In the evening, Swamishri was engaged in a meeting on BAPS rehabilitation program for the earthquake affected areas.
After his morning puja, Swamishri blessed all the devotees with words of wisdom.
At 3.00 pm, Swamishri was given an emotional farewell by the devotees of Auckland and welcomed in Singapore by the devotees at 8.00 pm (1.00 pm NZ time)

At 6.45 p.m., Swamishri inaugurated ‘Premvati Upahargruh’ in Akshar Vadi, Junagadh. Thereafter Swamishri inaugurated the newly built assembly hall called ‘Gunatit Sabha Mandapam’ named in honor of Aksharbrahma Gunatitanand Swami. The assembly hall has a seating capacity for 7,500 people.

Swamishri travelled to the tribal village of Poshina. Tribal devotees from distances as far away as 50 km had assembled for the satsang assembly. When Swamishri arrived he was welcomed by dancing tribal devotees. During the assembly Pujya Viveksagar Swami and Pujya Ishwarcharan Swami elaborated upon the work of Bhagwan Swaminarayan and the importance of satsang. Then a couple of tribal devotees spoke about the drastic moral transformations effected through satsang. A traditional tribal dance performance reflected their devotion and sentiments, ‘Aje aje sonaro suraj ugiyo re…’ Finally, Swamishri blessed the assembly of 8,000 tribal devotees, “Through satsang you have come to realise the dawning of a golden sun. God is like the golden sun and His devotees and sadhus are like the sun. When it dawns there is light within. Through the travellings of our sadhus in this region you have attained this path of satsang and the sun has become golden. Their discourses about God, morality, character and anti-addiction shed more and more light in our lives. Then when God and His Sadhu arrive one experiences light and peace through their darshan and spiritual association… God also belongs to the poor. The poor also offer their devotion and become redeemed. God is not pleased by wealth and power. To rob or harass another is not our goal. Our goal is to be happy and let others be happy…” After the tribal assembly, everyone present was served with dinner.
Due to Swamishri’s blessings and the efforts of sadhus and volunteers, out of 147 tribal villages in the region 120 villages have regular satsang assemblies.
At 6.15 pm Swamishri visited the BAPS Swaminarayan Mandir in Khed Brahma. After a brief address Swamishri left and arrived in Himmatnagar at 7.45 pm.

At 11.06 am Swamishri arrived in Bhavnagar from Mumbai. At 7.00 pm Swamishri presided in the welcome assembly at the mandir. Viveksagar Swami had addressed the assembly on the story of the BAPS centenary. Swami was garlanded and thereafter children and teenagers performed a traditional welcome dance on the bhajan, Ãj mãre orde re…. Then a short drama on Shastriji Maharaj was enacted.

Then the leading lights of Bhavnagar, Mayor Mehulbhai Vadodaria and others honoured Swamishri. After the dignitaries expressed their feelings Swamishri blessed the assembly, “Shastriji Maharaj established the Sanstha and Yogiji Maharaj had sanctified Bhavnagar many times. Shastriji Maharaj was a great person who revealed the knowledge and glory of Bhagwan Swaminarayan and a sadhu’s true path. Everywhere one sees the upasana of Bhakta and Bhagwan. One has to emulate Radha to offer bhakti to Krishna, Sita to offer bhakti to Ram, and Parvati to do puja of Shiv. This is an ancient tradition. Bhagwan Swaminarayan came on earth with 500 paramhansas out of which his abode was Gunatitanand Swami.”

st.t: H. H. Karekin II Visit Swaminarayan Akshardham
w: HH Karekin II, the Supreme Patriarch and Catholicos of all Armenians, arrived at Swaminarayan Akshardham in New Delhi with a delegation of diplomats from the Embassy of Armenia.

Atmaswarup Swami, the head of Swaminarayan Akshardham, welcomed them at 11.30 am by the Mayur Dwar. The delegation was given a guided tour of the monument, exhibitions and Neelkanth Yatra film. His Holiness performed abhishek of Shri Neelkanth Varni and remarked, “There is peace in the ambience of Akshardham.” He also added, “We are greatly impressed by this complex and extend our best wishes to you and your faithful. May God grant brotherhood to all nations and peace in the world.”
The delegation departed at 1.30 pm.

Swamishri performed the murti-pratishtha rituals of pujan and arti of murtis of BAPS hari mandirs in Tithal district, namely, Tejlav (Vadfaliya), Jatmandva (Dharampur), Orvan (Donja), Saraiya and Kudvel. Thereafter Swamishri blessed the devotees.
The sadhus were singing one another's virtues. Naming one sadhu, Prashantmuni Swami said, "He has one very great virtue. I have never seen him get angry."
Pramukh Swami Maharaj said, "That is very good. Through this everyone stays happy and satsang grows too. There are many ways of getting work done, so there is no need to get angry."
The sadhus were singing each other's virtues. Naming one sadhu, Prashantmuni Swami said, "He has one very great virtue. I have never seen him get hot tempered."
Swamishri said, "That is very good. It keeps everyone happy and satsang grows too. There are many ways to get work done, so there is no need to get angry."

This morning, as Mahant Swami Maharaj was going to the assembly hall holding the hand of Hiteshbhai Contact to give the devotees darshan of his puja, Hiteshbhai prayed to him, "Swamiji! Hold my hand just like this and take me to Akshardham."
Filled with feeling, Swamishri made a gesture as if pulling with his right hand and said, "We will pull you along and take you."

Gunatitanand Swami has said in talk 1/335, "God wants to make his devotee brahmarup (like Brahman) even if he has to beat him into it." In the same way, this great one too is sure to make us brahmarup. He is such that he will take us to Akshardham even if we do not want to go.

On 24 February 2017, BAPS Swaminarayan Research Institute in New Delhi organized its quarterly session of the Akshardham Lecture Series in the presence of Param Pujya Mahant Swamiji Maharaj and a large delegation at the Pramukh Swami Auditorium in Swaminarayan Akshardham. Themed ‘Yugvibhuti Pramukh Swami Maharaj,’ the session hosted enlightening talks on Pramukh Swami Maharaj’s life, work, and continued inspiration.

The session commenced by the chanting of Vedic mantras. Dr. J.M. Dave, Director of BAPS Swaminarayan Research Institute, welcomed the attendees and presented an overview of the theme of the series. Dr. Dave greeted and offered a brief introduction of each speaker and the subject of their presentations.

Delivering the first presentation, Viveksagardas Swami narrated his experiences with Pramukh Swami Maharaj. A senior sadhu of BAPS Swaminarayan Sanstha (BAPS), Pujya Viveksagardas Swami concluded his studies in engineering and received a doctorate for his Sanskrit work on Bhagawan Swaminarayan’s Akshar-Purushottam Siddhanta. Since then, he has authored numerous historical, philosophical, and inspirational publications and is a recognized world renowned orator. Having served on the senior administrative committee for BAPS for many years, Viveksagardas Swami has spent the last several decades with Pramukh Swami Maharaj in his travels. Bearing witness to Pramukh Swamiji’s tireless efforts for social and individual development, compassion, and divinity, Pujya Viveksagar Swamiji spoke on his firsthand account of Pramukh Swami Maharaj’s inspirational life and work.

Dr. W. Selvamurthy, thereafter, presented on how Pramukh Swami Maharaj’s virtuous living inspired change at personal, social, and global levels. President of the Amity Science, Technology and Innovation Foundation and the director general for Amity Directorate of Science and Innovation, Dr. Selvamurthy is a distinguished scientist who served as a Chief Controller, Research & Development (Life Sciences & International Cooperation) at the Defense Research and Development Organization for the Government of India. He is currently spearheading the research and development activities for the health and wellbeing of the armed forces and addressing social issues.

In his presentation, Dr. Selvamurthy recalled being introduced to Pramukh Swami Maharaj by the late Dr. Abdul Kalam and remembered experiencing a divine presence in Swamiji. Upon giving a brief biographical account of Swamiji’s life, he presented three virtues: truth, purity, and compassion, which he found to be most inspiring in Swamiji. He narrated biographical incidents from Swamiji’s life that exemplified these virtues and demonstrated how Swamiji showed the capacity to instigate both personal and social change through virtuous living. He then recollected Pramukh Swami Maharaj’s efforts for encouraging interfaith harmony, providing disaster relief, environmental awareness and care, rehabilitation, medical aid, and education; fostering sustained tribal development; encouraging support for women’s rights; creating opportunities for cultural expression and appreciation; and other humanitarian efforts. He concluded by presenting quotes from distinguished individuals, who had experienced a similar divinity in Swamiji’s work and virtuous living.

Thereafter, delegates and members of the session participated in launching the BAPS Swaminarayan Research Institute’s website. In the presence of Divine Holiness Mahant Swami Maharaj, the inauguration was greeted with great enthusiasm. The website offers an invaluable means for the expression of scholarly research conducted by members of the Institute, along with a forum to gain information on the Institute’s activities and projects. The homepage of the site may be accessed from the ‘Explore’ tab at akshardham.com or directly at the following address: http://swaminarayanresearch.akshardham.com/
